Adam Hlozek.note: Hložek is defined by waiting for a defender's attention to shift before moving. He opens his body on the first touch so he can play forward. He draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him.
Adam Hlozek.noteZh: 他靠等防守者注意力转移后再启动与同位置球员拉开差异。他会第一脚触球时打开身体，准备向前处理。他也会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。

Alexandr Sojka.note: Watch Sojka for seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Alexandr Sojka.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是比防线早一步看到决定性的传球。留意他如何穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。他也会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

David Doudera.note: Douděra is defined by creating a better angle for the next pass. He looks up before crossing and picks a runner rather than an empty area. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball.
David Doudera.noteZh: 他靠为下一脚传球制造更好的角度与同位置球员拉开差异。他会传中前先观察，再把球送向具体跑动者。他也会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。

David Jurasek.note: Jurásek is defined by making the safer decision before a duel becomes an emergency. He looks up before crossing and picks a runner rather than an empty area. He turns early and closes the runner before the box.
David Jurasek.noteZh: 他靠在对抗变成险情前做出更安全的选择与同位置球员拉开差异。他会传中前先观察，再把球送向具体跑动者。他也会提前转身，在对手进入禁区前缩短距离。

David Zima.note: Zima's signature is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
David Zima.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢上。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Denis Visinsky.note: Watch Višinský for making purposeful movement away from the ball. He protects the ball with his body and returns it into a runner's path. He changes pace after the defender has committed his feet.
Denis Visinsky.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是用有目的的无球移动创造接应点。留意他如何用身体护住球，再把球送回跑动队友的线路。他也会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。

Hugo Sochurek.summary: Hugo Sochůrek is a Czechia central midfielder from Sparta Prague who adds youthful passing range, pressure resistance, and long-term upside to the squad.
Hugo Sochurek.note: Sochůrek stands out for keeping the ball calm when pressure arrives. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support.
Hugo Sochurek.noteZh: 他的突出特点是压力到来时仍能让球保持稳定。他会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。他也会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。

Jan Kuchta.note: Watch Kuchta for pressing with a clear target rather than simply chasing. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back. He changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target.
Jan Kuchta.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是带着明确目标逼抢，而不是只追着球跑。留意他如何从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。他也会提前改变位置，为传球队友提供清晰目标。

Jaroslav Zeleny.summary: Jaroslav Zelený is a Czechia defender from Sparta Prague who can cover centre-back or left-back and gives the squad experienced defensive balance.
Jaroslav Zeleny.note: Zelený's edge is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He protects the route to goal and challenges only when the touch is loose. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it.
Jaroslav Zeleny.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。他会先封住通向球门的路线，再等待对手触球失误时上抢。他也会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。

Jindrich Stanek.note: Staněk stands out for sharp reactions backed by early positioning. He judges when to leave his line and takes pressure off his defenders. He keeps the line connected with constant small instructions.
Jindrich Stanek.noteZh: 他的突出特点是提前站位后的快速反应。他会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。他也会用持续而简短的提醒保持整条防线连接。

Ladislav Krejci.note: Krejčí's edge is creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He holds the route into the box until support arrives. He varies the height and pace of his delivery.
Ladislav Krejci.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是在防线重组前制造干净射门。他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。他也会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。

Lukas Cerv.note: Watch Červ for choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support.
Lukas Cerv.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢。留意他如何穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。他也会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。

Lukas Hornicek.summary: Lukáš Horníček is a Czechia goalkeeper from Braga who adds a young, high-upside shot-stopping option to the squad.
Lukas Hornicek.note: Horníček's edge is sharp reactions backed by early positioning. He changes position while keeping his priorities simple. He judges when to leave his line and takes pressure off his defenders.
Lukas Hornicek.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是提前站位后的快速反应。他会改变起始位置，但始终坚持清晰简单的处理原则。他也会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。

Lukas Provod.note: Provod stands out for delivering the ball without needing much space. He changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target. He changes pace after the defender has committed his feet.
Lukas Provod.noteZh: 他的突出特点是在很小空间里也能送出传中的能力。他会提前改变位置，为传球队友提供清晰目标。他也会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。

Matej Kovar.note: Kovář stands out for starting high enough to protect the space behind his defense. He chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in. He sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step.
Matej Kovar.noteZh: 他的突出特点是用靠前站位保护后防身后空间。他会在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。他也会在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。

Michal Sadilek.note: Sadílek's edge is creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Michal Sadilek.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是在防线重组前制造干净射门。他会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。他也会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Mojmir Chytil.note: Watch Chytil for giving centre-backs a physical problem they cannot ignore. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift.
Mojmir Chytil.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是让中后卫无法忽视的身体支点作用。留意他如何主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。

Patrik Schick.note: Schick's edge is creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target. He arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track.
Patrik Schick.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是在防线重组前制造干净射门。他会提前改变位置，为传球队友提供清晰目标。他也会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。

Pavel Sulc.note: Šulc's edge is creating a better angle for the next pass. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift. He protects the ball with his body and returns it into a runner's path.
Pavel Sulc.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是为下一脚传球制造更好的角度。他会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。他也会用身体护住球，再把球送回跑动队友的线路。

Robin Hranac.note: Hranáč's signature is recovering position without panicking after the first line is broken. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Robin Hranac.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在第一道防线被突破后仍能冷静回位上。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Stepan Chaloupek.note: Chaloupek's edge is the flexibility to fill different roles without breaking the team's shape. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He holds the route into the box until support arrives.
Stepan Chaloupek.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是在多个角色之间切换时仍保持球队结构。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Tomas Chory.note: Chorý is defined by giving centre-backs a physical problem they cannot ignore. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He keeps the line connected with constant small instructions.
Tomas Chory.noteZh: 他靠让中后卫无法忽视的身体支点作用与同位置球员拉开差异。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会用持续而简短的提醒保持整条防线连接。

Tomas Holes.note: Holeš is defined by the flexibility to fill different roles without breaking the team's shape. He varies the height and pace of his delivery. He protects the route to goal and challenges only when the touch is loose.
Tomas Holes.noteZh: 他靠在多个角色之间切换时仍保持球队结构与同位置球员拉开差异。他会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。他也会先封住通向球门的路线，再等待对手触球失误时上抢。

Tomas Soucek.note: Watch Souček for reading the flight of the ball before the duel begins. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support. He varies the height and pace of his delivery.
Tomas Soucek.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是在争顶前先判断球的飞行轨迹。留意他如何出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。他也会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。

Vladimir Coufal.note: Coufal stands out for seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. He holds the route into the box until support arrives. He looks up before crossing and picks a runner rather than an empty area.
Vladimir Coufal.noteZh: 他的突出特点是比防线早一步看到决定性的传球。他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。他也会传中前先观察，再把球送向具体跑动者。

Vladimir Darida.note: Darida is defined by calm decisions shaped by experience in high-pressure moments. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support.
Vladimir Darida.noteZh: 他靠高压时刻由经验带来的冷静判断与同位置球员拉开差异。他会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。他也会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。
